about: Part trymove's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row trymove, 'Inputs and outputs'). Places beyond gameroutine.py's are read by tools/native/gparts/checkpos.py's place() (gw: glayout's tic GW fields), which tools/native/gparts/trymove.py uses. P_TryMove takes its thing, x and y as upstream's _Dp[0-3], X:C, _Dp[4-7] (natively GA_0-1, GA_2-5, GA_6-9, as P_CheckPosition) and returns A (1 moved, 0 not); it takes tmfloorz, tmceilingz, tmdropoffz as checkPos does (a thing that blocks the check with MP_TRY 1 leaves the last check's); its callers read the check's tmfloorz, tmceilingz, tmdropoffz and ceilingline after it; numspechit ends at -1 when the crossed lines were walked ($FF natively). P_NightmareRespawn takes the dead monster in _Dp[0-3] (natively A:X) and returns nothing.
